rule: Long ES16 over the last session before each scheduled NYSE holiday (enter close H-2)

columns.net_1x: daily excess return over T-bill, net of realistic one-way cost 0.75 bp per unit notional (+ engine roll round trip)

scaling: L = min(5, 0.10 / (sigma_hat * sqrt(f_hat))) inside windows, fixed per window from the decision date two sessions before the first return day; sigma_hat = sqrt(252*EWMA_com60(r^2)) of the instrument's daily excess returns; f_hat = share of trailing 252 sessions in the rule's windows
execution: engine.simulate exec=next_close (weight held over day t decided at close t-2); calendar offsets on the planned NYSE calendar
notes: Meets the letter of the declared rule (alpha vs ES16 t 2.19) but collapses to 0.20 once the 51 pre-holiday days inside turn-of-month windows are removed. Based on 128 events.
